highlights: Seeds: a packet or seed lot that a planting was sown from can't be removed by mistake. The Remove dialog stays open and says why, and suggests setting its Status to depleted instead. Packets with nothing sown from them, saved lots and a Snap's Undo still remove as before.
Lots saved from farm-stand or gift produce no longer offer Set parent plant, which could only fail. Long planting names in a packet's germination list wrap instead of pushing the page sideways.
The heart, the clear ✕ on a chosen supplier or planting, and Remove item are easier to tap, and look the same.
